text.en: The gold square is the original. Grow the side and count how many copies fit.
text.as: সোণালী বৰ্গটো মূল। বাহু বঢ়াই কেইটা সোমায় গণা।

do.en: Make the side 2 times as long.

then.en: Four copies fit: the shape grew in two directions at once.

do.en: Now make it 3 times as long.

then.en: Nine copies. So diagonals in the ratio 2 : 3 mean areas in the ratio 4 : 9.

q.en: A square has area 441 sq cm. What is its perimeter?

why.en: The side is $\sqrt{441} = 21$, and there are four sides.
That is one side. The perimeter is all four.
